title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: panendrajadav/Suraksha-Khata
description: Suraksha Khata is an AI agent that reconciles a small UPI vendor's transactions against their declared business profile, classifying each as business-taxable, exempt, or personal — preventing shock GST notices driving vendors off UPI. Deterministic matching + LLM explanations only. Reports match rate & exceptions on 50+ synthetic records.

title: Spitfire-Products/nexus-cortex
description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

title: rajdeepchatale/agentpay-india
description: AI shopping agent for Indian merchants. Buyers speak or type in Hindi, Marathi, Hinglish or English; spending caps, consent and rate limits are enforced in deterministic code outside the LLM before any Razorpay test-mode order — every decision audit-logged with its reasoning.

title: Orkas-AI/Orkas
description: Open-source multi-agent AI desktop client — build and command your AI agent team through conversation. A commander LLM dispatches sub-agents in parallel or in series; agents self-evolve via reflection and skill crystallization. Local-first, BYO LLM keys (Claude · OpenAI · Gemini · DeepSeek · Kimi · GLM · Qwen). macOS / Windows / Linux.

title: CowDogMoo/squad
description: Squad runs unattended AI agents, defined as markdown plus YAML, against any LLM provider in bounded, cost-capped tool loops - locally or on Docker, Kubernetes, or EC2.

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: jdorner/palim
description: Self-hosted AI agent platform with extensions, workflows, and a web UI. Local LLM inference via llama.cpp (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: mockagents/mockagents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: Jafar-Pathan/Nudge
description: Nudge is an AI agent that recovers failed/abandoned Razorpay payments — an LLM engine (Groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b) decides recovery links, reminders, discounts, or upsells, gated by bounded rules and human approval. Built with Next.js, React 19, Prisma, and Neon Postgres.

title: yauntyour/cell.cpp
description: A lightweight AI coding agent written in modern C++26. Connect to OpenAI or Anthropic, chat with your codebase, and let the LLM read, write, edit, and execute — all sandboxed.

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it eliminates the need to re-explain context every time you switch tools or devices. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: mrdushidush/claudette
description: Air-gapped AI coding agent in one Rust binary + Q56, a hidden-test benchmark for local coding models: 16 configs, 36 full runs, no LLM judge. Runs entirely on your own hardware through Ollama or LM Studio. No cloud brain. No API key. No telemetry.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: agentd-dev/source-code
description: A minimal, MCP-native, cloud-native AI agent runtime. One small static Rust binary runs one agent: hand it an instruction and one LLM endpoint, and it runs the agentic loop — think, call a tool, observe, repeat — until the task reaches a terminal status or a new event wakes it.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp
description: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.

title: doctorzero666/HireNet
description: Multi-agent workflow platform: turns a business goal into structured tasks and routes each to an AI agent, a person, or both. Schema-validated LLM output, audit trail, exactly-once royalty settlement behind a pluggable provider interface. Flask + React, hermetic test suite, deployed.

title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper
description: Agent Vesper is a pure-Rust AI agent harness that remembers you across conversations. It provides a provider-neutral runtime where any LLM provider can plug in — today it ships with the Z.ai GLM adapter, tomorrow any provider can join with zero TUI or runtime changes.
